_comment: Telegram notifications to the owner chat (milestone 2) and, prepared but OFF by default, to a community chat (milestone 5). Dutch plain language, Europe/Amsterdam times with UTC in brackets, no advice words. Every message ends with footer.
footer: Observatie, geen advies. Alles wordt achteraf gemeten.

community._comment: Community channel (milestone 5), OFF by default: nothing is ever sent to another chat than the owner unless TELEGRAM_COMMUNITY_CHAT_ID is set AND TELEGRAM_COMMUNITY_ENABLED=1 in .env. TELEGRAM_COMMUNITY_PREVIEW=1 sends the community text to the OWNER as an extra message headed preview_header, within the owner limits (send.max_per_minute, observe.max_batches_per_hour). The rules below apply to the community channel and to the preview alike: at most one message per coin and per theme per per_key_cooldown_s, at most max_per_hour per hour, nothing during quiet_hours (local time of `timezone`; start == end disables), and a weekly accountability message (weekly: ISO weekday 1 = Monday, time_utc) that summarizes the go/no-go section of the week report in plain words. warning is the fixed line every community message carries.
community.warning: Geen advies. Hoog risico: de meeste van deze munten gaan naar nul. Alles wordt achteraf gemeten en gepubliceerd.
